assessment: Lukasz and colleagues report important new results revealing how changes in zebrafish lateral line hair cell synaptic activity results in increased vulnerability to ototoxic insult. The authors provide convincing evidence for neurotransmitter release altering susceptibility to aminoglycoside exposure through experiments examining mutants where synaptic release is disrupted. Changes in synaptic activity are accompanied by modest but significant changes in mitochondrial activity, consistent with previous studies revealing that mitochondrial changes impact hair cell susceptibility to damage. This work will inform future studies on how accumulating damage contributes to hair cell damage and ultimately hearing and balance disorders.
